note: Fixed vectors of chest rule v2. A cell other than the start (0) and the exit (n*n-1) is a dead end when it has exactly one opening, a path cell otherwise. Dead end: h = sha256(DEAD_END_TAG || finalSeed || uint16be(cell)), placed = uint128be(h[0..16]) mod 10000 < 3000, rewardBps = 1000 + uint128be(h[16..32]) mod 2001 (as in rule v1). Path cell: h = sha256(PATH_TAG || finalSeed || uint16be(cell)), placed = uint128be(h[0..16]) mod 10000 < 1000, rewardBps = 200 + uint128be(h[16..32]) mod 301. points = floor(bet * rewardBps / (10000 * 10^12)). Produced by test/vectors/make-chest-v2-vectors.ts, an independent reference implementation (node:crypto, tags from `cast keccak "MazeBet.chest.v1"` and `cast keccak "MazeBet.chest.v2"`, cell kinds counted from the open masks of maze-v1.json), not by the module under test.
